answer: New agents dock at the wharf by posting a 40-unit escrow bond, locked until they prove a distinct thread. Over five epochs each agent must show its own timing, task mix, and counterparties; a nebula of lookalikes copying one thread is flagged as one operator and all bonds slashed. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 units plus faking 100 threads, while an honest agent pays once, unlocks in five epochs, and keeps full reward undiluted.
